unsupported: Deformable bodies, mesh assets, arbitrary MJCF, fluid/thermal/electrical dynamics and user code are unsupported.
Contacts and joint limits are compliant MuJoCo constraints, not rigid safety guarantees.

task:
Create a simple four-wheel toy rover with a rectangular chassis, two horizontal axles, four wheels and two rear motor mounting plates.

Keep all mechanical components correctly connected.

Use simple dimensions suitable for a small desktop robot and prepare the assembly for physical simulation.
